","assert_live":"docker exec shared-temporal-1 temporal operator namespace describe --namespace "$STACK" >/dev/null
","down":"docker exec shared-temporal-1 temporal operator namespace delete \

    --namespace "$STACK" >/dev/null 2>&1
"},{"name":"images","down":"IMAGES=$(docker ps -a --filter "label=com.docker.compose.project=$STACK" \
           --format '{{.Image}}' | sort -u)

","assert_gone":"docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1                                  # no daemon ⇒ can't tell

"},{"name":"ingress","assert_gone":"# Prove the CHECK works before trusting its negative: the shared host must still answer, or a

"}]}
